tools.name: wikipedia_search
tools.description: [wikipedia] Full-text search of English Wikipedia. Use this to find the right article title, then call wikipedia_summary with it. Returns titles, short descriptions and excerpts, best match first.

tools.name: wikipedia_summary
tools.description: [wikipedia] Get the lead summary of an English Wikipedia article by its exact title (redirects are followed). If you are unsure of the title, use wikipedia_search first. Returns title, short description, the lead extract and the article url.

tools.name: hackernews_front_page
tools.description: [hackernews] List the stories currently on the Hacker News front page, ranked as on the site. Use this to see what is trending now; use hackernews_search to find stories on a topic. Returns title, url, points, comment count and story id.

tools.name: hackernews_search
tools.description: [hackernews] Full-text search of Hacker News stories (not comments) by keyword, ranked by relevance. Use this to find discussions about a product, project or topic; use hackernews_front_page for what is trending now. Returns title, url, points, comment count, date and story id.

tools.name: geocode_search
tools.description: [geocode] Turn a city or place name into coordinates. Use this before weather_forecast, which needs latitude/longitude. A name can match several places, so up to `limit` candidates are returned, best match first, each with name, country, region, latitude, longitude and timezone.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: [weather] Get current conditions and a daily forecast for a location given by coordinates. If you only have a place name, call geocode_search first. Returns temperature (°C), humidity, wind (km/h), WMO weather code, and per-day max/min temperature and precipitation (mm) in the location's local timez

tools.name: currency_latest
tools.description: [currency] Get the latest European Central Bank reference exchange rates (updated once per working day) from a base currency. Omit symbols to get all ~30 currencies. Returns an object with base, date and a rates map, e.g. rates.CNY.

tools.name: github_search_repos
tools.description: [github] Find public GitHub repositories matching a query. Use this when you don't know the exact repo; use github_repo when you already have owner and name. Supports GitHub qualifiers like 'mcp language:rust stars:>100'. Returns up to `limit` repos (full_name, description, stars, language, url, upd

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: [github] Get metadata for one public repository you already know by owner and name: description, stars, forks, language, license, topics, url and last push time. Use github_search_repos first if you only have keywords. Returns an error if the repo does not exist or is private.

tools.name: npm_package
tools.description: [npm] Get the latest version, description, license and homepage of an npm package. For download counts use npmstats_downloads instead. Returns an error if the package does not exist.

tools.name: npmstats_downloads
tools.description: [npmstats] Get how many times an npm package was downloaded in the last 7 days, as a popularity signal. For version or license info use npm_package instead. Returns package, downloads, start and end dates.

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: [arxiv] Search arXiv research papers by keyword across title, abstract and authors, ranked by relevance. Use it for academic preprints; use wikipedia_search for general background. Returns id/link, title, publication date, authors and abstract.

tools.name: holidaycn_year
tools.description: [holidaycn] List every official holiday day off and every make-up workday (调休上班) in mainland China for one year, e.g. to tell whether a date is a working day or plan around 春节/国庆. Returns entries of name (Chinese holiday name), date (YYYY-MM-DD) and isOffDay (true = day off, false = make-up workday)

tools.name: baiduhot_realtime
tools.description: [baiduhot] Get the current Baidu real-time hot search ranking (百度热搜榜): what Chinese internet users are searching for right now. Use it for Chinese news and trending topics; use hackernews_front_page for English tech news. Returns up to 50 entries of word (topic in Chinese), index (rank; the pinned i

tools.name: shici_random
tools.description: [shici] Get one random famous line of classical Chinese poetry (诗/词/曲), optionally from a theme. Use it for a daily quote, a greeting card line or a writing prompt. Returns content (the line), origin (poem title), author and category (theme path such as 古诗文-抒情-感恩).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: wikipedia_summary, hackernews_front_page, hackernews_search, github_search_repos, github_repo, baiduhot_realtime · Private data: github_repo · Public sink: github_search_repos.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: wikipedia_summary, hackernews_front_page, hackernews_search, github_search_repos, github_repo, baiduhot_realtime · Private data: github_repo · Public sink: github_search_repos

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "wikipedia_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "[wikipedia] Full-text search of Wikipedia. Returns titles, short descriptions and excerpts." → after: "[wikipedia] Full-text search of English Wikipedia. Use this to find the right article title, then call wikipedia_summary with it. Returns titles, short descriptions and excerpts, best match first."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
